# List of presidential trips made by Droupadi Murmu

Droupadi Murmu, the 15th President of India, has undertaken several domestic and international trips since assuming office on 25 July 2022. These visits are part of her ceremonial and diplomatic duties, including state visits, participation in summits, and outreach to Indian states and union territories.

| Lisbon
| 7–8 April 2025
| First state visit in 27 years. Ceremonial Guard of Honour given; awarded *City Key of Honour* by Mayor of Lisbon; meetings with President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa and PM Luis Montenegro. Cultural & diaspora engagement.

| Bratislava
| 9–10 April 2025
| First visit by an Indian president to Slovakia in 29 years. Held bilateral talks with President Peter Pellegrini and Prime Minister Robert Fico. Two MoUs signed (on MSMEs and diplomatic training). Addressed Indian diaspora and attended cultural programs.

| Vatican City
| 25–26 April 2025
| Represented India at the state funeral of Pope Francis. Laid a wreath at St. Peter’s Basilica and attended the funeral Mass with world leaders.
